tool.name: TRIDENT Tissue Segmentation
tool.description: Segment tissue regions from whole-slide images using TRIDENT

exit_code.description: Error occurred. Please check Tool Standard Error

tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/trident_segmentation.py' #for $i, $img in enumerate($input_collection) --input '${img}' --original_name "${img.element_identifier}" #end for --output_zip '$output_zip' --segmenter '$segmenter' #if $remove_artifacts --remove_artifacts #end if #if $remove_penmarks --remove_penmarks #end if --gpu $gpu_index #if $skip_errors --skip_errors #end if

param.name: input_collection
param.label: Input WSI Collection
param.help: Provide a dataset collection of whole-slide images (.svs, .tiff, .tif, .ndpi).

param.name: segmenter
param.label: Segmentation Model
param.help: Select the segmentation model to use for tissue detection.

param.name: remove_artifacts
param.label: Remove Artifacts
param.help: Run an additional model to remove artifacts (penmarks, blurs, stains, etc.) from segmentation.

param.name: remove_penmarks
param.label: Remove Penmarks
param.help: Run an additional model to remove penmarks from segmentation.

param.name: gpu_index
param.label: GPU Index
param.help: GPU device index to use for processing (0-based).

param.name: skip_errors
param.label: Skip Errors
param.help: Skip errored slides and continue processing remaining slides.

tool.help:
**TRIDENT Tissue Segmentation**
This tool segments tissue regions from whole-slide images (WSI) using TRIDENT's segmentation models.
**Inputs:** - **Input WSI Collection**: A collection of whole-slide images in supported formats (.svs, .tiff, .tif, .ndpi) - **Segmentation Model**: - **HEST**: Histology Enhanced Segmentation Tool - default, works with H&E and IHC stains - **GrandQC**: Fast H&E segmentation model - **Remove Artifacts**: Optional post-processing to remove artifacts (penmarks, blurs, stains) - **Remove Penmarks**: Optional post-processing specifically for penmark removal - **GPU Index**: GPU device to use (0-based indexing)
**Outputs:** - **Segmentation Results (ZIP)**: Contains: - GeoJSON files with tissue contours (can be opened in QuPath) - Thumbnail images with tissue contours overlaid - Segmentation masks
**Notes:** - This is the first step in the TRIDENT pipeline - GeoJSON outputs can be edited in QuPath for quality control - Processing time depends on WSI size and selected options - GPU acceleration is recommended for faster processing
**Citation:** If you use TRIDENT in your research, please cite: Zhang, A., Jaume, G., Vaidya, A., Ding, T., & Mahmood, F. (2025). Accelerating Data Processing and Benchmarking of AI Models for Pathology. arXiv preprint arXiv:2502.06750.
